component.name: SOL Engine
component.summary: Purpose-built runtime for the SOL Doom modification

description.p: SOL Engine is the dedicated runtime for SOL, a free Doom modification built on UZDoom technology.
A user-owned DOOM.WAD or DOOMU.WAD and an adjacent locally built sol.pk3 are required. Commercial Doom data and redistribution-restricted development resources are not included.
Establishes the native SOL Engine identity and boot contract.
